payload.description_html: Illustration from page 31 of The outline of history; being a plain history of life and mankind, the definitive edition revised and rearranged by the author, by H.G. Wells, illustrated by J. F. Horrabin, showing Early Pleistocene Animals contemporary with earliest Man (before Homo-Sapiens), six-foot man drawn to same scale, Hairy Mammoth, Reindeer, Heidelberg Man, Musk Ox, Sabre-tooth Tiger, Wild Horse, Wolly Rhinoceros.
